name: Hole part-five Fountain stack and Cove camp factors
description: Paired v1.23 Fountain position contents and values, capacity, overflow value, and Cove camp operands from the latest saved account.

extractions.label: stack_positions
extractions.expression: (() => { const holes = idleon.getAttr('Holes'); const royalMulti = idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'Fount_RoyalMulti', 0, 0); const stackBonus = idleon.callFunction('Holes', 'B_UPG', 95, 10); const positions = holes[29].map((itemCurrencyIds, space) => { const royal = Number(holes[34][space]) >= 1; const itemValues = itemCurrencyIds.map(currencyId => { const coinValue = idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'Fount_CurrencyTotValue', Number(currencyId), 0); const stackFactor = 1 + itemCurrencyIds.length * stackBonus / 100; const ordinaryValue = coinValue * stackFactor; const royalValue = royal ? Math.max(1, royalMulti - 1) * coinValue * stackFactor : 0; return ordinaryValue + royalValue; }); return { space, itemCurrencyIds: itemCurrencyIds.map(Number), royal, itemValues, value: itemValues.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) }; }); const occupiedSpaces = positions.filter(position => position.itemCurrencyIds.length > 0).length; const spaces = idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'SpacesOwned', 0, 0); const maximumStackSize = idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'MaxStackSize', 0, 0); return { spaces, maximumStackSize, maximumCoins: idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'MaxCoinz', 0, 0), occupiedSpaces, itemCount: positions.reduce((sum, position) => sum + position.itemCurrencyIds.length, 0), positions, overflowValue0: idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'Fount_CurrencyTotValue', 0, 0) * idleon.callFunction('Holes2', 'Fount_CurrencyKEEP', 0, 0) }; })()
